newsitem.title: USA: Miami motorist with corpse killed in shootout.
newsitem.headline: Miami motorist with corpse killed in shootout.

text.p: A man sitting in a parked car with a rotting corpse opened fire on police and was then shot and killed by the officers, Miami police said Wednesday.
A caller told a police dispatcher Tuesday night a man was sitting in a car with a dead woman. Police found the car, saw the corpse and asked the man to get out, police spokesman Rudy Espinosa said.
"He began shooting at the officers," Espinosa said.

The unidentified man shot Hialeah Police Officer Julian Guerra in the arm and Metro-Dade Detective Chris McManus in the hand. The pair returned fire, fatally shooting the man in the head, Espinosa said.
McManus and Guerra were hospitalized but were in good condition.
Police were still trying to identify the dead woman, who is believed to have been the man's wife or girlfriend. They do not know how or when she died but described the corpse as badly decomposed.
